defect: I-03 (SC-3420/3411): For a Term-Defined line on the plain list-priced path, the net (ItemNetTotalPrice) is never multiplied by the fractional PricingTermCount, so QLI NetTotalPrice stays at the full unprorated amount (750) instead of 250*3*0.7397 = 554.79. Root cause: the ONLY step in V21 that multiplies NET by PricingTermCount — the SubscriptionPricing step (label "Subscription Pricing", output ItemNetTotalPrice, ProrationMultiplier=PricingTermCount, NetUnitPrice=NetUnitPrice) — lives inside the ListGroup "EvergreenanytimeprorationfilterLinelevel" (seq 28), whose entry filter ListOperation87 requires SellingModelType='Evergreen'. Term-Defined lines fail that filter, so neither the native Proration BKM (leg A) nor the net-proration SubscriptionPricing (leg B) ever executes for them. The only proration leg a Term-Defined line CAN enter is ListContainer97 -> SubscriptionPricing99, whose gate ListOperation98 is (SellingModelType='TermDefined' OR 'Evergreen'), but that leg writes TotalLineAmount from InputUnitPrice — it prorates the LIST column, never the NET. Hence the net is unprorated. This confirms the spec's FIX note ("gate the proration leg on SellingModelType=TermDefined regardless of whether a discount/adjustment is present") and REFUTES the deploy note ("no deploy; stale data; re-test with a fresh UI line") — a fresh Term-Defined line hits the identical Evergreen-only gate and reproduces the unprorated net. Note: the gate is on SellingModelType (='Evergreen'), NOT on presence of a discount/adjustment; the spec's 'adjustment/discount' framing is imprecise but the fix direction is correct.

proposedEdits.why: Broadens the entry filter of the net-proration ListGroup (EvergreenanytimeprorationfilterLinelevel) to admit Term-Defined lines that have an end date (mid-term), so the native Proration BKM derives the fractional PricingTermCount and the SubscriptionPricing net leg multiplies NetUnitPrice by it, writing the prorated net into ItemNetTotalPrice. Keeps the existing Evergreen-anytime branch (1 AND 2 AND 3) byte-for-byte and adds an OR branch (4 AND 3) = SellingModelType='TermDefined' AND itemTransientEndDate IsNotNull. Criterion 3 is reused (shared) so it must remain; TermDefined without an end date (full-term) is intentionally excluded because PricingTermCount would be a whole number and the existing full-term math is unaffected. NOTE: this is a canvas-level fix per the V21 in-place rule (MDAPI deploy does not reach the runtime engine); the oldString/newString here define the exact condition to reproduce in the Pricing Procedure canvas for ListOperation87, not a file-deploy path.

fieldsVerified: All fields referenced by the edit already exist in the V21 block (file lines 110855-117766): SellingModelType appears 10x (e.g. criteria at 114378/114420/114476/115046 and as Proration/SubscriptionPricing BKM inputs at 115787), AllowPartialProrationPeriods appears as a criteria/BKM input (e.g. 114386, 115780), and itemTransientEndDate appears 3x as the EffectiveTo/IsNotNull field (e.g. Proration input at 114891 and ListOperation87 criterion 3 at 114393). No new context field is introduced. Currency context (STICurrencyIsoCode, 8 refs incl. FX formulas at 113134/113262) is present but irrelevant to this defect — I-03 is currency-agnostic. The edit only rewrites conditionLogic and appends a 4th criterion reusing SellingModelType.
risks: 1) Routing TermDefined into EvergreenanytimeprorationfilterLinelevel also runs the native Proration BKM (leg A) and the seq-3 net SubscriptionPricing; both take SellingModelType as an input so they handle TermDefined correctly, but the native BKM will now DERIVE PricingTermCount from EffectiveFrom/itemTransientEndDate. If an upstream step already stamped the QLI PricingTermCount (evidence shows 0.7397 present), the native BKM re-derivation must agree with it — verify the recomputed multiplier equals the stamped 0.7397 in the waterfall; a mismatch would mean the two proration sources disagree. 2) ListContainer97/SubscriptionPricing99 (the LIST leg, gate ListOperation98) ALSO fires for TermDefined and writes TotalLineAmount from InputUnitPrice*qty*PricingTermCount; with the net now prorated too, confirm the downstream FormulaBasedPricing3 (TotalLineAmount = IF(ItemNetTotalPrice > TotalLineAmount, ItemNetTotalPrice, TotalLineAmount)) and the ItemNetTotalPrice>0 guards don't clobber or double-apply. 3) InputUnitPrice may be null on a plain list line (no discount ran) — if so SubscriptionPricing99 could yield null/0 for the LIST column even though the NET now prorates; that is a separate LIST-column symptom to watch, not caused by this edit. 4) MUST be applied in the RLM canvas and activated from the Versions list (per V21 in-place rule); an MDAPI-only deploy will not change runtime behavior and a canvas re-save on activate can clobber other in-place edits — re-verify K-01/F-12/G-01 after activation.
controls: Re-reprice the following to prove no regression and confirm the fix: (a) the failing Term-Defined mid-term plain list line — expect NetTotalPrice = 250*3*0.7397 = 554.79 (was 750); (b) an Evergreen anytime-proration line (AllowPartialProrationPeriods=true, end date set) — expect its prorated net UNCHANGED, proving the preserved (1 AND 2 AND 3) branch still fires; (c) a full-term Term-Defined line (no itemTransientEndDate / whole-number PricingTermCount) — expect net = full list, proving the new OR branch's criterion 3 (end-date IsNotNull) correctly excludes it; (d) a One-Time/Perpetual line (SellingModelType != Evergreen/TermDefined) routed through ListContainer90 — expect unchanged (PTC=1); (e) an Evergreen fixed-term line hitting ListContainer94 (AllowPartialProrationPeriods=false, end date null) — expect unchanged. Also re-verify the previously-PASSing Portion-1 fixes (K-01/F-12 StampBaseFilter, G-01 Base_Price__c UnitPrice) after canvas activation since activation can clobber in-place edits.
